messages:
rita singh: Heads-up: deploying route-optimizer v3 to canary during the quiet window. We'll use feature flag `route.optimizer_v3` with a conservative ramp and a manual holdpoint at 30%.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled (ID: db-22219). Canary replicas: 5. Healthchecks active.

noah rivera: Ramp suggestion: 0.5% -> 2% @10m -> 10% @25m -> 30% @50m (manual hold) -> 70% @120m -> 100% after 4h stable. Rollback if error_rate >0.4% OR p95 increases >90ms.

li chen: Note: model cold-start + KV warming may create a ~3-5m latency tail. We should add a 4m ignore window for p95 after each step. Also add pin target `route-optimizer-v2` with TTL=1800s.

rita singh: good call. Adding tracing debug for the first 10m after 30% step. @noah you'll own the 30% hold.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 0.5%. Healthchecks passing.

noah rivera: advanced to 2% at +11m. p95 +22ms, errors stable. moving to 10%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 10% in progress.

li chen: 10% steady. preparing pin script: `curl -X POST https://internal/flags/pin -d '{"flag":"route.optimizer_v3","version":"route-optimizer_v2","ttl":1800}'`

noah rivera: 30% holdpoint reached. metrics good. holding for manual sign-off from oncall.

rita singh: oncall cleared. proceed to 70% but keep auto-rollback armed.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback rule attached: criteria error_rate>0.4% OR p95_delta>90ms. Action: rollback to route-optimizer-v2 and pin for 30m.

noah rivera: slight EU region latency drift at 70% but under thresholds. continuing soak.

deploy-bot: Ramp complete: route-optimizer v3 at 100% traffic. No rollback triggered.

rita singh: Thanks team. I'll add a brief release note: "route-optimizer v3 rolled out via staged feature flag ramp; warmup guidance; auto-rollback/pin configured." Filing follow-up to revisit warmup ignore window in next retro. :tada:
